PENTARYN_AOE.CannotRemove: You don't own those templates. Ask the GM to remove them.

Tray.Superseded: Superseded by a newer damage roll for this area. Apply from that one.
Tray.WaitingTip: Waiting for the player to roll from the request card.
Tray.RollFor: Roll this save for the player
Tray.ApplyFailed: Damage could not be applied to {names}. The other creatures took their damage; press Apply again to retry.
Tray.NobodyToPing: No connected player is waiting on a save.

handleTokens.Name: Area handles
handleTokens.Hint: Put a small token on every spell area. Drag it to move the area; delete it to delete the area. Everyone owns it.

removeAreaButton.Name: "Remove all templates" icon
removeAreaButton.Hint: Put a Remove all templates icon next to Place Template on every spell card that places an area. It removes every template that spell placed on the scene you are viewing.

instantCleanup.Name: Remove instantaneous areas after Apply
instantCleanup.Hint: When every ticked row of an instantaneous spell (Fireball) has been applied, delete its area.

concentrationCleanup.Name: Remove areas when concentration ends
concentrationCleanup.Hint: When a caster stops concentrating, delete that spell's areas on every scene.

resolveSaves.Name: Saves from the area
resolveSaves.Hint: When a save spell's damage is rolled, list the creatures in its area, roll the monsters' saves and ask the players for theirs. Nothing is applied until the GM presses Apply.

npcSaveRollMode.Name: Monster save visibility
npcSaveRollMode.Hint: Roll mode for saves the GM's client rolls for monsters.

autoApplyNpc.Name: Apply monster damage automatically
autoApplyNpc.Hint: Apply damage to monsters as soon as their saves are rolled, without pressing Apply. Players' characters always wait for Apply.

promptPlayers.Name: Ask players to roll
promptPlayers.Hint: Post a request card so each player rolls their own character's save.

autoDamageOnHit.Name: Roll damage on a hit
autoDamageOnHit.Hint: After an attack roll that hits (or whose target is unknown), roll its damage straight away on the attacker's client. A known miss or a natural 1 rolls nothing.

autoApplySelf.Name: Apply self-cast effects automatically
autoApplySelf.Hint: When a spell card's only target is the caster (Mage Armor, Fly or Invisibility on yourself), or the spell can only affect its caster (Shield), put its effect on the caster straight away. A card with several effects is a choice (Guidance's skills) and stays in the tray. The GM's client does it, so players don't need to open the Effects tray.

highlightUnapplied.Name: Highlight effects not yet applied
highlightUnapplied.Hint: Outline a card's Effects tray and mark it "Not applied yet" until someone applies its effects. Cards older than an hour are left alone.

carefulSpell.Name: Careful Spell protects the creatures the player chooses
carefulSpell.Hint: When a sorcerer uses Careful Spell, they pick up to their Charisma modifier (minimum one) of the creatures on their scene, and a chat card names them. The next save spell's tray marks exactly those creatures protected: an automatic success and no damage on a half-damage spell, no request card. Then it ends; a spell with no save leaves it waiting, and using it again replaces the choice. The GM can protect or unprotect any row in the tray with its shield.

refundCancelledArea.Name: Refund a cancelled area
refundCancelledArea.Hint: If a spell's area placement is cancelled (Escape or right-click), give back the slot, charges or uses it spent and remove its card, as the card's Refund button would.

playerStatus.Name: Tell the caster when damage is waiting for the GM
playerStatus.Hint: Players see one line under their own save-spell damage card: waiting for the GM to apply, applied, or re-rolled. No monster save numbers. Monsters' GM-only save rolls are hidden from players' chat instead of showing as "privately rolled" rows.

untargetedSelf.Name: A touch spell cast at nobody goes on the caster
untargetedSelf.Hint: A touch spell for one willing creature (Mage Armor) cast with nothing targeted lands on the caster, with the usual "Applied to …" line on the card. Off: it waits in the GM's effects tray.

noSpellStacking.Name: The same spell does not stack
noSpellStacking.Hint: When a spell's effect goes on a creature that already has that spell's effect from another source (Shield from a slot, then from a Ring of Spell Storing), the old one is replaced instead of adding a second (PHB: the effects of the same spell don't combine).

aimSelfAreas.Name: Self cones and lines start at the caster
aimSelfAreas.Hint: Placing a Self-range cone or line (Cone of Cold, Burning Hands, Lightning Bolt) keeps its point at the caster's token and points it at the mouse; click to cast. Off: core's placement (the point follows the mouse, the mouse wheel turns it).

cancelTemplate.Name: Cancel template placement
cancelTemplate.Hint: While you are placing a spell's area, this key cancels it on the first press, even with a sheet open. At any other time the key does what it normally does.

Careful.PickHint: Choose who it protects (up to {n}). On your next spell that calls for a saving throw, they succeed automatically and take no damage where a success would halve it.
Careful.Nobody: Careful Spell: there is no creature on this scene to choose.
Careful.Protect: Careful Spell: protect this creature (an automatic success, no damage where a success halves it)
Careful.Unprotect: Careful Spell: take the protection off (back to its own save)
Careful.RowTip: Careful Spell: an automatic success, and no damage where a success halves it.
Careful.Head: Careful Spell protects: {names}

Status.waiting: Saves are in. Waiting for the GM to apply the damage.
Status.superseded: Re-rolled: the newer damage card for this spell is the one that counts.

Refund.Done: {item}: placement cancelled, so nothing was spent. The slot, charge or uses are back.
